purpose: A run of long-form prose in the one shared prose container.

shape.grouped: an ordered list of {heading, paragraphs[]} — T-DETAIL-*, T-COMPARISON, T-ARTICLE
shape.flat: a flat ordered node list (p / h2 / h3 / ul / ol / blockquote / figure / pExternal) — T-LEGAL, T-STORY, T-PILLAR

groupedSections.maxItemsBasis: recomputed: the longest real grouped body is 4 {heading, paragraphs[]} sections (glossary detail)

flatNodes.maxItemsBasis: recomputed: 70 nodes on /privacy-policy, 31 on the longest T-PILLAR prose block, 25 on /terms-of-service

constraints.maxPerPageBasis: recomputed from src/data/pillar.js: T-PILLAR composes exactly 7 prose blocks between its other blocks (indices 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 of its 17-block array).
constraints.maxPerPageScope: maxPerPage 7 is the T-PILLAR prose-block count. On T-LEGAL and T-ARTICLE (2.0.0) the body is emitted as ONE NODE PER HEADING-BOUNDED CHAPTER / LEGAL PART (R6), so the count there is the document's own heading count (20 parts measured on /privacy-policy at 1440px) and maxPerPage does not apply. Advisory: not enforced by the semantic validator.

motion.note: NO prose reveal, no scroll-progress bar, no sticky table of contents.

copyPolicy: LONG-FORM PROSE IS DELIBERATELY PLACEHOLDER, NOT THE ORIGINAL'S WRITING. See the repo README's 'What is real and what is placeholder' section. Headings, labels and titles ARE real; the running prose is generated to the original's measured block heights.
motionClosureScope: CLOSED for PageSpec emission: a generated node's `motion` object may contain ONLY the fields in motionFieldSet, enforced by schema/pagespec.schema.json (additionalProperties:false) and the MOTION_OBJECT_IS_CLOSED rule. The keys in motionDocumentationFields below are contract-level documentation carried by THIS file for human and retrieval use; they are NOT settable on a PageSpec node.
